description: MeSH-anchored indication registry. Stable ids used as FKs from disease-insights manifests, keyword cluster files, and the lexicon. The single source of truth — keyword_lexicon.json no longer carries its own meta.indications.

items.label: Lupus Nephritis
items.description: Kidney manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Spans induction/maintenance immunosuppression, renal labs, and progression to CKD/ESRD.

items.label: Melanoma
items.description: Cutaneous and metastatic melanoma. Spans surgical excision, immunotherapy (anti-PD-1, anti-CTLA-4), targeted therapy (BRAF/MEK), and surveillance.

items.label: Obesity
items.description: GLP-1 weight-management corpus (WCT GLP-1 interviews). Metabolic comorbidities (diabetes, PCOS, sleep apnea) sit under this indication as comorbidities.

items.label: Multiple Sclerosis
items.description: Autoimmune demyelinating disease of the CNS. Spans the disease-modifying therapy (DMT) landscape (anti-CD20, S1P modulators, fumarates, alpha-4 integrin, interferon-betas), MRI-based monitoring, EDSS-based disability tracking, and disease courses (RRMS, SPMS, PPMS). CAR-T programs targeting CD19+ B cells (e.g., KYV-101, Descartes-08) are in development for refractory / progressive MS.
